subtopic: THIRD SESSION-SEVENTEENTH PARLIAMENT 22-23 GEORGE V, 1932 VOLUME I, 1932 COMPRISING THE PERIOD FROM THE FOURTH DAY OF FEBRUARY, 1932, TO THE FOURTEENTH DAY OF MARCH, 1932, INCLUSIVE BEING VOLUME CXCI FOR THE PERIOD 1875-1932 INDEX ISSUED IN A SEPARATE VOLUME OTTAWA F. A. ACLAND PRINTER TO THE KING'S MOST EXCELLENT MAJESTY 1932 CANADA

speechtext: The parliament which had been prorogued from time to time to the 4th day of February, 1932, met this day at Ottawa, for the despatch of business.
